mapper.select: select cpdv_llave as llaveTabla ,cpdv_plantilla as plantilla from pedidoventa_pdvp pp left join account.comprobante_cmp cc on cc.ccmp_documento = pp.cpdv_llave and cc.ccmp_estado = 'A' where pp.cpdv_plantilla = #{pTemplateId} and pp.cpdv_estado != 'I' and pp.dpdv_fecha >= #{pStartDate} and pp.dpdv_fecha < #{pEndDate} and cc.ccmp_llave is not null order by pp.dpdv_fecha desc
